subject: ARR variance triage + pipeline gating for board packet
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ARR variance triage + pipeline gating for board packet

Team —

Board packet deadline is creeping up (Nov 14). We discovered a ~$1.2M variance between the ARR corridor and the rollforward that finance pulled. Need a quick, surgical cleanup so numbers we present are defensible. Key asks: 

- Vivek: run commits for all >$100k ARR deals and flag anything with stage changes in last 30 days.
- Laura: reconcile rollforward (booking-run) to ARR tabers and call out FX/discount adjustments.
- Karthik/Neha: sweep pipeline for deals in Late Commit and Confirmed – lock stage or provide evidence.

I uploaded a working workbook (ARR-evidence-Q3-Q4.xlsx) with a 'triage' tab — please populate the "evidence" column with links or short notes (contract signed, PO, SOW email, DocuSign ID).

Timing: please update your sections by EOD Thu (Nov 5). If you can't, say so and I will escalate to CS/account owner.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ARR-evidence-Q3-Q4.xlsx]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR variance triage + pipeline gating for board packet

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Board packet deadline is creeping up (Nov 14). We discovered a ~$1.2M variance ...
> 
> Timing: please update your sections by EOD Thu (Nov 5).

I've started the commits export and matched stage history. Initial findings:

- CloudSentry (NW-2026-1173) shows $420k ARR in "Late Commit" with a signed SOW found in the customer thread dated 10/21. I attached the export line in the triage tab.
- Two other opportunities ($140k total) shifted from "Commit" -> "Negotiation" after discounting; I flagged both as "needs evidence".

Actioning: I'll add DocuSign IDs where available and ping CS for missing signatures. If CS can't produce signed SOWs, we'll gate them out of the board corridor.

[Vivek]
Head of Sales Ops
[Attachment: CloudSentry-commit-export-20261104.csv]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR variance triage + pipeline gating for board packet

Marissa / team —

I reconciled the rollforward to bookings and the shortfall is primarily timing (recognition vs. contract effective date) plus two manual credit memos we forgot to remove. Numbers:

- Rollforward at 11/1: $28.94M ARR
- Board corridor target: $30.14M ARR
- Identified issues: $0.62M timing (move to Q1), $0.18M credit memos, $0.40M late-evidence (pending confirmation) = $1.2M gap.

I updated the workbook and added a PDF snapshot (booking-rollforward-10-26.pdf). For CloudSentry: the PO email we have is approved but not a signed SOW. Procurement asked for a single consolidated invoice — I recommend we ask them to provide the DocuSign envelope ID or toggle stage to "Late Commit - Evidence Pending".

Laura
Head of Finance (FP&A)
[Attachment: booking-rollforward-10-26.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR variance triage + pipeline gating for board packet

Quick status:

- Locked: 8 deals (>$2.1M) with signed SOWs / PO emails attached in the triage tab.
- CloudSentry: reached out to Olivia (cc'd below) to request DocuSign envelope ID and consolidated invoice.
- Flagging process proposal: any deal >$100k without a signed SOW goes to "Late Commit - Evidence Pending" and is excluded from board corridor until evidence is provided. Approve?

-Karthik
VP, Enterprise Sales

From: Olivia Zhang <olivia@cloudsentry.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@cloudsentry.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ARR variance triage + pipeline gating for board packet

Thanks for the ping — apologies for the delay. Procurement confirms the PO and the SOW were approved internally on 10/20, but the DocuSign envelope wasn't completed due to an internal signature routing issue. Attached is a consolidated invoice and a note from our procurement lead confirming intent to pay. I can share the DocuSign envelope ID by EOD Wed.

If helpful, treat CloudSentry as committed for the board narrative but we understand finance will classify it as "Evidence Pending" until the envelope ID is uploaded.

Best,
Olivia Zhang
CFO, CloudSentry Inc.
